notes.title: #7 Disease, Disease Chain, Vitality Rework + small tweaks
notes.content:
DISEASE
Reworked Disease to now incorporate disease chain in it to get to the fun faster, 
Disease can now chain to multiple enemies like a domino effect

SPLATTER
You now have the option to convert disease stacks into AOE HP damage
Additionally there is a pickup that can increase this AOE

VITALITY
standardized extra healing bonus to 25% and now has the ability to increase the dropchance of HP pickups for those interested in lifesteal and Ram builds

Small tweaks
- To promote adaptive building boss upgrades now give +1 to the main stack if you decide to alternate 
- Separation of hitboxes for walking into enemies and hitting them with projectiles
- Small adjustments of enemy positions to cater to new upgrades and new movement

notes.title: #6 Movement, Burn, Burn Damage and Execute rework
notes.content:
Big gameplay updates in preparation for a new character model as well as increasing the oomph of the game

MOVEMENT
Player movement got completely reworked into a system without strafing and now as an addition braking, 
This is new system requires less unintuitive inputs to be needed to execute maneuvers
-------

BURN
Burn was quite a non-unique DOT, so in the rework the behavior got changed

Burn now escalates every 12 ticks, applying previous damage with a multiplier. Burn damage is now called Devastation

Level 1 Devastation decreases ticks from 12 to 10 to escalate
Level 2 causes an escalation to have 25% chance to spawn a flaming meteor leaving lava puddles behind
level 3 Applies +5 damage on hit for your main projectile if the target you're shooting is on fire
-----

EXECUTE
Execute got changed from a passive upgrade to an active drop

Execute multiplies all projectile damage in the first 0.25 seconds by the amount of stacks the player has picked up. If execute kills a target the player receives 1 execute stack
-----

Otherwise small quality of life changes got introduced like having a restart button when pausing
